problem: ARIES listened but never answered; the user reported that the silence is what made it not feel alive. The hard constraint was Macedonian, and the field had already disqualified most options: Piper publishes 177 voices in 58 languages with no Macedonian (its 'sr_RS' voice is Lower Sorbian data mislabelled upstream), Meta MMS-TTS lists 1143 languages in its own file manifest without mkd, and XTTS-v2, Kokoro and a Hugging Face search return nothing trained on Macedonian speech.
change: New package aries/speech/ with speak(text, language=None, blocking=False), stop(), speaking(), warm() and available(), playing through pw-play (pactl does not exist here). Three interchangeable engines selectable per language: espeak-ng via ctypes over the libespeak-ng that piper-tts already links statically (no apt, no root); Piper bg_BG-dimitar-medium driven by espeak-ng's Macedonian front end instead of its own Bulgarian one; and Microsoft's mk-MK-AleksandarNeural over edge-tts. Macedonian defaults to the Microsoft voice with automatic fallback to the local Piper voice when the network fails; English uses Piper en_US-ryan-medium. Added the 'say' capability to aries/workspace/capabilities.py (CATALOGUE, recognize in both languages, ARGUMENTS, execute) and scripts/aries-fetch-voice for parallel voice downloads.
validation: Measured on this machine, synthesis only, no speaker: espeak-ng load 28 ms, +19.6 MB RSS, first sound 4.9 ms, RTF 0.0020; Piper load 826 ms, +91.4 MB RSS, first sound 98 ms, RTF 0.046; Microsoft first sound 0.4-1.5 s, no local cost. All CPU; the GPU was left alone because aries-voice.service holds Whisper large-v3 there. Streaming verified by chunk counts: a four-sentence Macedonian reply through Piper emits 4 chunks, the first at 81 ms carrying 0.57 s of audio while the remaining 393 ms of synthesis finishes under it; Microsoft emits 16-33 MP3 chunks per sentence and so starts mid-sentence; espeak emits one. Every phoneme espeak-ng 'mk' produces has an id in the Bulgarian voice's table (zero unknowns over the reply vocabulary), pinned as a test. tests/test_speech.py adds 42 checks and passes. Voice choice was decided by the user listening to all three say the same sentence, not by argument.
limitations: Two suites fail in the shared working tree (test_learning_eval, test_lifecycle) from another agent's uncommitted changes to workspace/retrieval.py and workspace/models.py; on a pristine HEAD tree with only these speech changes applied, both pass. The chosen Macedonian voice needs the network and Microsoft's undocumented endpoint, and the sentence leaves the machine; the local fallback speaks Macedonian words in a Bulgarian accent, and ќ /c/ in particular degrades to к because espeak writes it as 'k^', a symbol the Bulgarian voice never saw in training. Latin product names inside Macedonian text are handled by a 20-entry transliteration table, so any name outside it will be mispronounced by the local engines. Nothing was tested from inside aries-voice.service; pw-play is only known to work from an interactive session, where pw-record already works for the same unit.
